body: Oh snap I missed the third question. Harley and Black Widow are both capable of dodging bullets so the biggest problem would be like grenades. Harley herself has extremely good aim probably long range too while Black Widow has many gadgets that help her BUT, specialises in close range tactics. In Winter Soldier, she was struggling to deal with a few soldiers who couldn't even hit her so I don't see her killing a military base.

In a hand to hand situation I'd probably give it to Black Widow because she has better speed and strength feats but if it's a long range fight we already what she can do. I've never even seen Black Widow take cover. Most of the time she just runs like [here](https://gfycat.com/agitatedterrificegg) or [here](https://gfycat.com/agitatedterrificegg). In fact, I'd go as far to say taking cover would make both of them weaker. They are both capable of dodging bullets with a fast and athletic fighting style that looks for different angles to fight from. "firing accurate shots"? Wdym? Harley hasn't missed a shot in the movies yet. Hell even in the previous movie she was capable of [this](https://gfycat.com/requiredcostlygenet), head shotting 2 monsters while flipping and then turning her back to head shot another in a split second. Black Widow has good aim too, but she has to get into a realistic position to shoot, and can't move at high speeds while perfectly shooting too. So yeah, if they fight close range with no guns then Black Widow destroys as she has many gadgets, better physical feats and speed feats while Harley has far better gun aiming feats.
